purpose: Eliminate ambiguity in issuer-level weighting before any additional historical candidate query or price/return access.

clarification.reason: canonical_security_id is already deterministic and frozen in the historical reconstruction path; using later manual legal-name completion would create an unnecessary post hoc grouping dependency.

analysis_effect.within_unit_aggregation: Median D+10 excess return across all frozen cohort events sharing the same canonical_security_id.
analysis_effect.primary_statistic: Median across canonical_security_id-level D+10 excess-return medians with equal unit weight.
analysis_effect.maximum_single_issuer_event_share: Maximum share of frozen cohort events belonging to one canonical_security_id.
